create_resnet_lipreading_model: create a ResNet model for lipreading with configurable block type, layer depths, and relu activation
build_basic_block: build a BasicBlock residual module with configurable stride, downsample, and relu or prelu activation
create_downsample_layer: create a downsample block using 1x1 conv or avg-pool plus 1x1 conv for channel and spatial reduction
create_conv3x3_layer: create a 3x3 convolutional layer with configurable input/output channels and stride
test_resnet_forward_pass: test the ResNet forward pass with a 4D tensor input and verify output shape after adaptive pooling
